name: Ocamonte (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green, the yellow crossed by a red diagonal wedge, the white charged with a green triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Ocamonte, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: thin red wedge across the yellow stripe
small green triangle on the white
